content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Classification: deviation** (fails fallback on data return; walk-away territory).

- **What exists:** § 11.4 (p0192) is a real Termination Assistance clause — triggered six months pre-expiry or on any termination for any reason, all necessary assistance, transition planning on our schedule, continued Services up to six months, charges at M&I's then-current rates. Those three preferred elements are already met and were mapped as `already_met` with verbatim quotes, not re-drafted.
- **What is missing:** no return or export of Customer Data anywhere. § 17.1 gives ownership only, § 17.5 gives security safeguards only, and the § 23 source-code licence expires with the Term — none supplies an exit mechanic. That defeats even the fallback 30-day export.
- **Cure:** a single inserted § 11.5 carrying only the three still-missing elements (30-day return, machine-readable format, certified deletion), with deletion anchored to completion of Termination Assistance so it does not contradict the retained six-month continued-Services mechanic. No survival tail, expense language or procedure was added; the at-our-expense basis and 100-day election notice were noted in the rationale rather than flagged.
